content.description: Fanton is a fantasy football game built for Telegram and Web3 users. Its site describes creating or joining leagues, drafting players, tracking rankings, watching highlights, getting pick advice, and playing free tournaments. The app belongs in the TON games set because the main product is competitive sports gameplay distributed through Telegram. Create or join a fanton fantasy football league, draft players, track rankings, watch highlights, get pick advice, and more!. Users see this through how to play, featured tournaments, and play for free and experience the thrill!.
